note: The radio's layout tokens: a copy of what its page descriptions (ui/OpenZone_Radio_VPP) take from the core's ui/tokens.json -- the vpp* colours of the OpenZone admin window (the trader's metal, VPP rework 2026-11-12, design 2.3), the fonts, and the spaces and sizes the descriptions name. Read at the default path (no [build] tokens in dayz-mcp.toml). edge, panel and none are here because the generator draws them itself: every field's frame in $edge and its ground in $panel, every gap in $none; they keep the core's series values, and the window repaints them to its metal when the page registers (OZ_VppPaint). The engine does not read this file, and neither does the core: change a value in the core's tokens, change it here, and in OZR_VppMetal for script colours.
